scripts._comment2: BROWSERSTACK DIRECT RUN (From PC to Cloud, no Docker)
scripts.test:cloud: cross-env TEST_TARGET=browserstack npx browserstack-node-sdk playwright test
scripts._comment3: CI PIPELINES (Triggers Docker on GitHub servers via GitHub CLI)
scripts.ci:docker: gh workflow run "Playwright Tests inside Docker" -f test_environment="github-local"
scripts.ci:browserstack: gh workflow run "Playwright Tests inside Docker" -f test_environment="browserstack-cloud"
